Mapped water lengths and approaches reserve a new rail structure envelope. Bridge type, navigational clearance, hydraulics, scour, geotechnics, approvals and cost remain open.

civil.cost_scope: Standard elevated carrying deck and supplies include residual interface allowances and temporary works. Iraqi benchmarks price incremental station civil, finishes and equipment per served line over the common carrying deck, street access once per site, and one additional access-package equivalent for transfer circulation at each site. Track/walkways cover the permanent running way, while erection track is temporary and recovered. The corridor land/utilities allowance concerns property, diversions and public disruption beyond booked erection lanes and separately leased yards. The matched road comparator retains the source's two local yards on eligible open sections. All three prices are budget hypotheses in constant 2026 money. Apply project design, commissioning and contingency once on the integrated capital ledger. The curved and short-stock premium is applied once to both matched methods.

programme.basis: Relative calendar days with independent road teams and two-end launcher pairs. Each road team reserves one casting yard and each deck job reserves two terminal yards. Terminal yards are relocated by work package and the model retains mobilisation and site setup for every package. The held day/night and foundation-release scenarios, road permits and stock schedules require contractor evidence. The finish is a standard-deck handover envelope. Opening requires other programmes.

standard_stock_materials.basis: Recurring 20 m stock and spread footing trial only. Match supports and lift geometry to surveys.

water_screen.basis: Geometry screen on retained mapped water polygons. Short canals, parallel basins, bridge length, approaches, high water and pier clearance require separate survey.

crew_shifts.role: Haul driver for loaded round trip

workforce.labour_basis: Crew availability covers posts and paid shift hours. Gantry payroll is priced once in erection, road labour in operated plant and haul, casting labour in fabrication, and indicative standard support and permanent track labour in their works allowances. Support and track figures transfer outline productivity assumptions. Station, utility, special-crossing, testing and operations crews require separate contractor or operator workplans.

cost.basis: Constant 2026 USD planning allowances. Fleet follows the 18-hour, six-minute service offer; take-up and timetable capacity need operating evidence. Construction funding dates are open.

Utility connections, electrical protection and grid failure cases
